attr.title: SpaghettiKart
attr.desc: SpaghettiKart is the HarbourMasters PC port of Mario Kart 64, built from the decompilation, with enhancements such as higher frame rates, widescreen support and mod support.
attr.inst: Copy your Mario Kart 64 US .z64 rom to ports/spaghettikart/baseroms. The sha1 sum must be 579C48E211AE952530FFC8738709F078D5DD215E; other versions will not work. The rom is converted to mk64.o2r on first launch, which can take a few minutes.
